answer: Sleeper farm wakes: 1,000 dormant zephyr accounts whisper the vote at once, betting old history still counts. Under reputation decay it does not. Weight comes only from peer-checked work in the last two epochs and halves after two idle epochs, so a silent identity's opal badge fades to near zero before voting. Rebuilding one fake costs 20 verified task-hours, so 1,000 fakes cost 20,000 task-hours every cycle, not a one-time setup. This defeats sleeper-farm ambushes, since stored history cannot be banked and replayed. Trade-off: an honest returner restarts half-blind and must re-earn standing.
